hotspots.title: Trump Rally Tour Fuels Midterm Fever
hotspots.blurb: President Trump and Vice President JD Vance are aggressively blanketing battleground and red states with campaign rallies to boost Republican candidates ahead of the pivotal November midterms, drawing intense protests and local disruption.
hotspots.affect: The mobilization of massive rallies combined with vocal counter-protests charges the discourse with high electoral stakes and partisan urgency.

hotspots.title: White House Staff Chaos and High-Profile Resignations
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration faces fresh internal turmoil following the abrupt departure of press secretary Katie Zacharia after just five days on the job, alongside broader scrutiny of cabinet stability and personnel churn.
hotspots.affect: Rapid-fire personnel drama and conflicting departure narratives project an image of institutional instability and high-stakes chaos.

hotspots.title: Trump Admin Hardline Immigration and Citizenship Push

hotspots.affect: Provocative framing around cultural integration and economic pressures drives fierce political polarization in Scandinavian coverage.
